description:
Affiche un `iframe` natif encapsulé dans un composant sans Shadow DOM,
avec prise en charge de :
- `src`
- `srcdoc`
- zoom
- sandbox
- interaction

attributes.name: controls
attributes.description: Shows the internal toolbar for zoom and frame actions; controls="false" hides it.

attributes.name: fullscreen
attributes.description: Allows the embedded document to request fullscreen when present.

attributes.name: interaction
attributes.description: Enables pointer interaction with the embedded document; interaction="false" blocks pointer events. Enabled by default.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Browser iframe loading policy: lazy defers offscreen loading; eager requests immediate loading. Absent leaves the browser default.

attributes.name: referrerpolicy
attributes.description: Referrer policy forwarded to the iframe, for example no-referrer or strict-origin-when-cross-origin. Empty leaves the browser default.

attributes.name: sandbox
attributes.description: Space-separated iframe sandbox permissions, for example allow-scripts. In this component, empty or absent removes the sandbox; an empty attribute does not enable the fully restricted native sandbox.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of the document to embed; a nonempty srcdoc takes precedence.

attributes.name: srcdoc
attributes.description: Inline HTML document to embed, taking precedence over src.

attributes.name: zoom
attributes.description: Nonnegative numeric magnification factor: 1 is 100%, 0.5 is 50%, and 2 is 200%. Invalid values use 1.

attributes.name: zoom-levels
attributes.description: Space-separated zoom choices offered in the toolbar, expressed as percentages, for example 50% 100% 150%.

methods.name: getContentHeight(): number
methods.description: Returns the maximum scroll/offset height of the embedded document in CSS pixels. Returns 0 if its document is unavailable, including inaccessible cross-origin content.

methods.name: resetZoom(value = 1): void
methods.description: Sets the magnification factor to value; 1 restores 100%. Rejects negative or nonfinite values with TypeError.

methods.name: zoomIn(): void
methods.description: Selects the next larger configured zoom level, capped at the largest available level.

methods.name: zoomOut(): void
methods.description: Selects the next smaller configured zoom level, capped at the smallest available level.

events.name: tp-iframe-change
events.description: Emitted when zoom, interaction or horizontal viewport state is refreshed. overflowWidth and scrollPosition are in CSS pixels, zoom is a scale factor, and zoomText is its percentage label.
events.detail: { interaction: boolean; overflowWidth: number; scrollPosition: number; zoom: number; zoomText: string }

events.name: tp-iframe-load
events.description: Emitted after the inner iframe loads and its layout is refreshed. contentHeight is in CSS pixels (0 when inaccessible), hasSrcdoc indicates inline content, and src is the configured URL.
events.detail: { contentHeight: number; hasSrcdoc: boolean; src: string }

cssproperties.name: --tp-iframe-zoom
cssproperties.description: Unitless scale factor applied to iframe content (1 means 100%); synchronized with the zoom attribute.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-iframe>` element implements the <tp-icon name="iframe" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Iframe functionality: controlled iframe component.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Reading | Read the displayed content and use its links and embedded controls. |
| Using the component | The component itself adds no editing or playback controls. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| Focused controls | Use each control’s standard keyboard interaction.  |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
